scenes.sense: Coated in thick mud or grime
scenes.description: Thick gooey brown mud and a boot stuck in it, mud dripping off the boot, a muddy field.
Thick orange soup falls from a spoon into a saucepan in a heavy ribbon.
Three people sit apart at a table, looking sideways while one turns away with folded arms.
Two padded beaters touch a large drumhead surrounded by overlapping vibration circles.
